registration.source: Four asymmetric native registration marks on chart 1

reference.source: Datacolor SpyderCheckr Color Data V2, columns E-H (Spyder Checkr 24)
reference.reference_space: sRGB; convert to XYZ D65 before fitting
reference.layout: six rows, four columns; white at top left, dark skin at bottom right

limitations: Assumed sRGB JPEG transfer; no sensor RAW
Nominal chart reference values; illumination spectrum not measured
Spatial illumination and specular reflection not corrected
